value.eligibility_evidence: The Scarborough row, "Winter Recreation: North York and Scarborough Wednesday, December 9, 7 a.m.", carries only a location district and no resident or non-resident label, so it is unclassified. The preview sentence, "Winter activities will be added to the registration and booking system to view and plan on November 17", is a browse date with no eligibility label.
value.note: The page prints no year for the November 17 preview or the December 9 registration opening. It states 2027 only for the winter program dates ("between January 4 and April 2, 2027"), so the year of these two dates is left open. The registration time is 7 a.m.
